name: Marcus
summary: First-generation sophomore at a state school, about 8 hours a week, tight budget.
story: Marcus is aiming for a cloud engineering internship. He works part time, so he has roughly 8 hours a week and about $100 to spend, and wants to see which options fit those limits.

name: Priya
summary: Junior with three semesters left who needs to sequence opportunities carefully.
story: Priya is a junior with three semesters left. She wants to lay out certifications, projects and recruiting windows across that time without overloading any term.

name: Devon
summary: Weighing a certification, a side project and a student org, and curious how outcomes differ.
story: Devon is deciding between a certification, a side project and a student org, and wants to see how each one differs in time, skills, signaling and reported outcomes.
